description: Version 2 grades fact lookup, cross-document chronology, witness contradictions, impeachment material, machine-transcript questions, and questions whose answer is not in the record. It covers two synthetic matters, Harbor Street and Lumen Yard, and names near-miss passages that must not be treated as support. No real person or case is represented.
